settings.question: What should I ask if I am not sure which phone to choose?
settings.answer: Tell us where the phone will be used, who needs to call, how rough the handset may be treated, and whether battery life or rugged construction matters most.

settings.question: Can I receive launch or marketing updates?
settings.answer: Yes. Use the opt-in checkbox on the contact form to receive text or email updates and marketing information. You can opt out later.

settings.question: How does the referral offer work?
settings.answer: The supplied offer is: refer a friend and earn 1 free month of service.
